description: [Obsolète] Rémi - points arrêt routiers sur les lignes scolaires is a dataset listed in data.centrevaldeloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Ce jeu de données est obsolète. Il est remplacé par: REMI Point d'arrêts scolaires. Coverage: Centre-Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité, geospatial. Its keywords are mobilité, Rémi, transport, ramassage scolaire, déplacements, arrêts. The portal shows 8,447 records. The portal shows 2026-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-centrevaldeloire-fr-portal.
